title: fix(plugin-auth): the uncoded refusals on /change-email and /update-user carry an ADR-0112 code
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9AeLjhsRgNzegLA69SC8sCc)_
Fixes #29163

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`/change-email` 改成自己当前邮箱、未配置邮件服务时改邮箱、`/update-user` 没有可改字段,这三种拒绝原来只有英文 message 没有 code,现在都带上台账里已有的 code(`VALIDATION_ERROR` / `EMAIL_SERVICE_REQUIRED`)。
- 为什么改:同一个入口的其它拒绝都带 code,客户端只能靠匹配英文文案区分这三种,无法按 ADR-0112 的 code 分支和做本地化。
- 风险与回滚:只在 after hook 里给这三句厂商原话补 code,状态码、文案、拒绝与否都不变,不改 better-auth;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/account-self-service-refusal-code.ts`(识别条件)、`auth-manager-after-hook.ts`(两处调用)、`change-email-delete-user-wiring.test.ts` 末尾新 describe。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/account-self-service-refusal-code.test.ts src/change-email-delete-user-wiring.test.ts`,预期 17/17 通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- New `account-self-service-refusal-code.ts`: in the global `after` hook, a 400 `APIError` with no `code` on `/change-email` or `/update-user` whose message is exactly one of the vendor's listed sentences is re-thrown with the same status and message plus a ledgered code. Anything else passes through untouched, including a future vendor release that codes these itself. Same seam and recognition shape as the invite-member `ROLE_NOT_FOUND` stamp.

| Door | Vendor sentence | Code added |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `POST /change-email` | `Email is the same` (own address, any letter case) | `VALIDATION_ERROR` (standard catalog; the code this door already answers for a malformed address) |
| `POST /change-email` | `Verification email isn't enabled` (no email transport) | `EMAIL_SERVICE_REQUIRED` (`@objectstack/plugin-auth` ledger; the code the invite import answers for the same deployment condition) |
| `POST /update-user` | `No fields to update` | `VALIDATION_ERROR` |

- `auth-manager-after-hook.ts`: calls the stamp last in the `/change-email` section (after the old-address notice logic, which only acts on success) and right after the invite-member stamp for `/update-user`.
- No new error code, no `packages/spec` edit, no better-auth change, no change to which requests are refused.

## Tests

- `change-email-delete-user-wiring.test.ts` (existing file, new `describe` at the end, reusing its harness): the three refusals on the wire, each asserting status + full body `{ message, code }`, that nothing was mailed or changed on the own-address refusal, and a preservation case that the vendor's already-coded siblings (`VALIDATION_ERROR` for a malformed address, `EMAIL_CAN_NOT_BE_UPDATED`, anonymous `UNAUTHORIZED`) answer byte-for-byte as before.
- `account-self-service-refusal-code.test.ts` (new): every listed sentence is stamped on its own door; seven answers are left alone (listed sentence on the other door, uncovered path, unlisted sentence, vendor-coded body, non-400, success, inherited object key as path).
- No existing test needed an edit.

## Acceptance notes

- **Body shape.** The card delta asked for `{ success:false, error:{ code, message } }` "like the door's other refusals". Measured, the door's other refusals answer the vendor's flat `{ message, code }` (table in Verification), so the stamp keeps that shape: re-shaping only these three would make one door answer in two dialects. The flat shape is what every vendor-served auth route answers today.
- **Sibling measurement** (also in Verification): an address already taken answers `200 {"status":true}` by design (vendor anti-enumeration), so it is not a refusal to code.

## Verification

Base `0c0d3b68` (origin/main at branch point) vs head (see report), plugin-auth `AuthManager.handleRequest` harness, better-auth 1.7.12:

<details><summary>Premise and sibling refusals, measured on base</summary>

| Request | Base answer |
|:--|:--|
| change-email, own address | 400 `{"message":"Email is the same"}` |
| change-email, own address upper-cased | 400 `{"message":"Email is the same"}` |
| change-email, no email transport | 400 `{"message":"Verification email isn't enabled"}` |
| change-email, malformed address | 400 `{"message":"[body.newEmail] Invalid email address","code":"VALIDATION_ERROR"}` |
| change-email, missing newEmail | 400 `{"message":"[body.newEmail] Invalid input: expected string, received undefined","code":"VALIDATION_ERROR"}` |
| change-email, address already taken | 200 `{"status":true}` |
| change-email, anonymous | 401 `{"message":"Unauthorized","code":"UNAUTHORIZED"}` |
| update-user, `email` key | 400 `{"message":"Email can not be updated","code":"EMAIL_CAN_NOT_BE_UPDATED"}` |
| update-user, `{}` or only undeclared keys | 400 `{"message":"No fields to update"}` |
| update-user, array body | 400 `{"message":"[body] Invalid input: expected record, received array","code":"VALIDATION_ERROR"}` |

Head: the three uncoded rows answer the same status and message plus the code in the table above; every other row is unchanged (pinned).

Clause-②: same requests refused on base and head (400 / 400 for all three), only `code` added: `no`.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (each mutation through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to the HEAD blob, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

- A1 throw replaced by `return` → 4 failed (the three wire cases + the stamp unit case).
- A2 sentence check dropped → 1 failed: `leaves every other answer alone` (`/update-user: expected APIError: Email is the same … to be undefined`).
- A3 already-coded guard dropped → 1 failed: `leaves every other answer alone` (`/change-email: expected APIError … to be undefined`).
- After each: `ok restored: blob == HEAD (017cbf052f72) and git diff HEAD is empty`.

</details>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth test`: Test Files 209 passed (209), Tests 3616 passed, 10 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck`: lock VERDICT command-exit 0 (src, examples, test layer held in test-typecheck-debt.json).
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the four touched `.ts` files: exit 0 (plugin-auth has no own `lint` script; the repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's).
- Dogfood auth tests after the `@objectstack/dogfood^...` closure build (exit 0): `admin-platform-admin-standing`, `admin-route-nonadmin-refusal`, `mcp-oauth-api-action-forward`, `auth-session-audit-trail`, `discovery-auth-families`, `bearer-lane-password-change`, `admin-credential-lifecycle`, `account-oauth-tokens-not-serialized`: Test Files 8 passed (8), Tests 63 passed (63).
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 61 derived, 61 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, every line with its exit code, all 0. Three first exited non-zero for setup reasons and were re-run green: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (exit 3 until its pinned fixture commit was fetched into the shallow clone), `check:dts-closure` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 1 / 3 while a closure build was rewriting `dist/`; green after it finished).
